name: mail-duplicate-orders
description: A partner sees duplicate orders since this morning and asks whether the production resent messages: a current failure that OcuTalon can look into with its read-only tools, so it acts.

item.subject: We see duplicate orders from you
item.text: Hello, since this morning our system shows the same orders twice. Please check whether your production resent messages and which orders are affected. Thanks, Order Partner Operations
